rationale: Adds passive own-device LQI from Zigbee2MQTT and cached ZHA without diagnostic entities. One entry-owned volatile runtime, authenticated minimal projection and shared resolver serve all existing LQI surfaces; HA remains the fallback. Stable v1.82.0 requires state/attribute diagnostics.

summary.ru: Zigbee-сигнал напрямую из Zigbee2MQTT и ZHA без включения диагностических сущностей.
summary.en: Read Zigbee signal directly from Zigbee2MQTT and ZHA without enabling diagnostic entities.
